title: Dataset of an EEG-based BCI experiment in Virtual Reality using P300
description: This dataset comprises electroencephalographic recordings from 21 healthy subjects performing a visual P300-based brain-computer interface task in two environments: a personal computer and a virtual reality headset. The study compares BCI performance and user experience across these modalities using a 6×6 matrix speller paradigm with 16-channel EEG acquisition at 512 Hz. The dataset includes raw EEG data with event annotations and timing information relevant for event-related potential analysis.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 21 subjects using 16 electrodes (10-10 montage) at 512 Hz sampling rate with a g.USBamp amplifier and wet electrodes. Two randomized sessions (PC and VR) were conducted, each consisting of 12 blocks of 5 repetitions. Each repetition involved 12 flashes of groups of 6 symbols in a 6×6 matrix, with target and non-target stimuli presented visually. The VR condition used a passive HMD (VRElegiant) with a Huawei Ascend Mate 7 smartphone. Visual feedback was provided after each repetition. Reference electrode was placed at the right earlobe with ground at AFZ.
